classification.summary: The closed-source SwapNet Router's swap entrypoint (selector 0x87395540) performed a low-level call to a caller-supplied target with caller-supplied calldata and no target validation, so passing a token address made the router itself execute transferFrom() against users' standing infinite approvals.

sources.note: onchain review: victim proxy created 2025-11-08 by 0x9cb8d9bae84830b7f5f11ee5048c04a80b8514ba (not the attacker); four Upgraded(address) events with the implementation in log data, the last on 2025-11-21 pointing at 0xdc3914ca7b18a2bf41b43a263258b71e32296d7d. The anchored tx is the attacker's contract-creation tx whose constructor moved 13,342,433.169249 USDC from victim 0xba15e9b644685cb845af18a738abd40c6bcd78ed to the attacker EOA; the reported incident total across Base/BSC/Arbitrum is $13.43M for 18 users. The EIP-1967 implementation slot has since been zeroed.
